translations.web: But not so with you. But one who is the greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.
translations.bsb: But you shall not be like them. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.
translations.kjv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
translations.asv: But ye shall not be so: but he that is the greater among you, let him become as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that doth serve.
